summary_en: Stock exchange completed 2026-07-01 making Ichigo Holdings (pizza dough manufacturing, food products, soft drinks) a 100% subsidiary of Taiyō Bussan. Contract executed 2026-04-24 and approved by both companies' extraordinary shareholders' meetings 2026-06-30. No dissenting notices filed during statutory notice period. Financial impact under review.
title_en: Progress Report: Completion of Full Subsidiary Status of Ichigo Holdings Inc. through Stock Exchange
translation_en_brief: Taiyō Bussan announced on 2026-04-24 its intent to acquire Ichigo Holdings Inc. via stock exchange, with Taiyō Bussan becoming the full parent company and Ichigo Holdings the wholly-owned subsidiary. The stock exchange agreement was approved by both companies' boards on 2026-04-24 and subsequently by their respective extraordinary shareholders' meetings on 2026-06-30. No dissenting shareholders filed objections during the statutory notice period (commenced 2026-06-04). The stock exchange took legal effect on 2026-07-01, completing the full subsidiary status. Ichigo Holdings manufactures pizza dough, food products, and soft drinks; it was established in 1948 and is based in Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture. The company's capital is ¥225M. Taiyō Bussan has indicated that the financial impact on consolidated results is under review and will be disclosed once consolidated reporting methodology is finalised in consultation with the external auditor.
